title: Mendelow's power–interest matrix
caption: Power and interest sort stakeholders into four strategies. For the new supermarket, the planning authority is managed closely, while residents and small shops are kept informed until they gain power.
alt: A two by two grid. High power and high interest: manage closely. High power, low interest: keep satisfied. Low power, high interest: keep informed. Low power, low interest: monitor. The supermarket example's stakeholders are placed.
description: High power, high interest: manage closely, such as the local planning authority.
High power, low interest: keep satisfied, such as a regulator not yet engaged.
Low power, high interest: keep informed, such as local residents and small town-centre shops.
Low power, low interest: monitor with minimal effort.
